title: Rhythm game! Try it please
author: s00pr
selftext:
A rhythm game where you play a hexagon to live, ever-changing music. Earn Applause, recruit followers who play their own tunes, and lead your growing band under starlit skies. 🎶🎶🎶

https://s00pr.itch.io/bards-following

I made it ”public” one week ago and hit no traction. It gave me a lot of motivation and have been redoing many things.

The game have multiple functions, where one is the rhythm game itself, which is now the main part.  
Is it easy to start, too haaard?

Collecting followers are not earned automatically any more. And you have your new Isle to visit them at.  
Are the followers enough to make you wanna collect more (graphic-wise, and uniqueness)?

You can play on web or download APK for Android 🙂
